title: Shared agent definition
description: Vendor-neutral role definition. Lives in agents/<category>/<id>.md as YAML frontmatter; the markdown body is the human-readable instruction. Adapters generate .claude/agents/*.md and .codex/agents/*.toml from this.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must match the file name.

summary.description: One sentence: what this role does. Feeds the adapter `description` field used for auto-delegation.

responsibilities.description: The narrow set of outcomes this role owns. Anything not listed is out of scope.

must_not.description: Hard guardrails — actions this role never takes even if asked.

risk_escalation.description: Per-risk override of the resolved tier. e.g. { security: reasoning }.

required_context.description: Named context slices this role always needs (resolved by context-manager against source-of-truth). Not file paths.

produces.description: Outputs: code, tests, task-log, and artifact types from artifact.schema.json.

handoff_targets.description: Agent ids this role may hand off to directly. Blockers always route through project-manager regardless.

tools.description: Vendor-neutral capability names. Adapters map these to Claude `tools` / Codex `sandbox_mode`. Omit to inherit the runtime default.

skills.description: Skill ids to preload / reference. Must resolve to a directory under skills/.

read_only.description: True for review/research roles that never modify the working tree.

when_to_use.description: Optional disambiguation for adapters when two roles overlap (e.g. fullstack-developer vs backend-developer + database-engineer).

preload_skills.description: Subset of skills whose FULL text is injected into the agent at spawn (costs tokens on every spawn). Everything else in skills is discovered on demand through the Skill tool via its description. Keep this to 0-2.

runtime_hints.description: Optional token/safety hints. Adapters map the ones their runtime supports and ignore the rest.

max_turns.description: Stop the agent after N turns (Claude: maxTurns). Output is marked partial and resumable.

omit_project_instructions.description: Skip CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md for this agent (Claude: omitClaudeMd, v2.1.271+). Only for agents fully briefed by the delegation prompt.

auto_compact_window.description: Per-agent auto-compact threshold in tokens (Claude: autoCompactWindow, v2.1.296+).

isolation.description: Run in a temporary git worktree (Claude: isolation).
